newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Dec 22.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Dec 22.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Gulf Arab states discuss in Qatar ways of attracting foreign investments to the region.
- Iraq needs $25 billion to regain its previous production capacity, experts.
- Egypt and Morocco sign a cooperation deal in electricity sector.
- Some $500 billion from Gulf Arab states are invested abroad, Qatar's chamber of commerce chairman says.
- Saudi Arabia plans to set up a new industrial city at a cost of 1.5 billion riyals with the help of the private sector, Saudi officials say.
